public_rationale: The accessible contemporaneous report describes infrastructure plans but does not establish a first profitable year or an exclusive explanation. A March 26 report names 2029 for positive cash flow, but it is outside the observation window and uses a different measure. It cannot fairly contradict what Zitron said about expectations on March 24. The central earlier projection report was inaccessible.
limitations: The absence of an explanation in a short article does not establish that no explanation existed.
Later forecasts cannot be backdated without evidence.
A commercially optimistic explanation still counts as an explanation.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI does not expect profit until 2030 and has no explanation of how it will get there beyond building Stargate.

statement.excerpt: It does not anticipate being profitable until 2030, and does not have any explanation as to how they will become so other than “we will build Stargate.”
statement.document_title: The Phony Comforts of AI Optimism

from_speaker: does not anticipate being profitable until 2030
our_interpretation: This is an observation about OpenAI's expectations and explanations at publication, not a prediction that profitability will actually arrive in 2030.
The plain reading concerns company-wide profitability and a stated commercial route to it. A plan can count as an explanation without proving it will succeed.
Use the first quarter of 2025 through March 24 as the current reporting window for the expectations described. Earlier plans matter only if shown still applicable.
The surrounding context relies on press reporting of internal projections, so their basis is estimate.
Do not substitute a cash-flow breakeven date for a net-profit date.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous projections identify 2030 as the first profitable year, and sufficiently complete descriptions of the plan establish that Stargate is its only explanation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous projections identify an earlier first profitable year on the same basis, or contemporaneous records describe another substantive route to company-wide profitability.
